name: early-retiree-bridge-gap
facts:
Goal: maximize wealth at the end of the plan (terminal wealth), planning to age 85.
- Age 45, single filer, wants to retire at 50.
- Gross income $100,000 a year; can save $10,000 a year.
- Will spend $70,000 a year in retirement.
- Balances: $800,000 traditional (pre-tax), $200,000 Roth, only $50,000 taxable brokerage.
- Leave Social Security and pensions out of the plan. No employer match.
- Happy with the assistant's default assumptions for everything else.
